verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents debugging and troubleshooting in natural language, plus querying and editing large codebases. That covers narrowing down root causes and applying fixes. Nothing documents running code to reproduce issues or running tests to verify fixes, and hands-on reports of agentic tool-call failures lower confidence without directly contradicting the debugging claim. Missing for 10: documented issue reproduction (command/test execution), documented fix verification workflow, independent corroboration of debugging effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language
Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
